title: 30-Day Fitness Challenge Results Thumbnail
summary: This prompt generates a YouTube thumbnail for a "30-Day Fitness Challenge" results video, featuring a split-screen transformation of the YouTuber's physique. It highlights high subject consistency to showcase impressive.
